description: Finish 2.0 Phase 28 — Support/ops 2.0 expansion: 2.0 feature FAQ, structured refund matrix, additional known issues. Extends post-1.0 support-runbook.json; support.html sections. Distinct from post-1.0 Phase 28 baseline runbook and post-1.0 Phase 28 content tooling.

featureFaq.title: Weather & tide
featureFaq.body: Weather and tide change catch weights and presentation. They are sim systems at 20 Hz — not cosmetics. Check the HUD weather/tide strip; storms and festivals can stack tips.

featureFaq.title: Festival weekends
featureFaq.body: Seasonal festival windows boost crowd and sale tips while active. The festival HUD banner is presentation; economy tips come from the event catalog.

featureFaq.title: Achievements & species journal
featureFaq.body: Achievements unlock from sim stats. The species journal/codex tracks logged fish — open from the HUD. Neither changes wages or prices.

featureFaq.title: Fishing mastery & staff trees
featureFaq.body: Mastery coaching tips and staff specialization branches are progression UI over existing hire/upgrade rules. Staff schedules stay offline-friendly.

featureFaq.title: Contracts 2.0 & daily goals
featureFaq.body: Delivery chains and reputation-gated contracts sit beside classic quests. Daily goals / offline journal summarize progress after away time — claim rewards from Goals.

featureFaq.title: Language & accessibility
featureFaq.body: Settings → Language supports English and Spanish for UI chrome. TalkBack/keyboard titles cover 2.0 panels; raise HUD text scale or enable reduced motion if needed.

featureFaq.title: Cloud offline queue
featureFaq.body: If a cloud push fails, the latest snapshot is queued and flushes on resume/online. Conflict UI still asks when local and remote both look valid. Rules snippet is operator-applied (not auto-deployed).

featureFaq.title: Web checkout (local)
featureFaq.body: Without VITE_BILLING_API_BASE the web client uses a local entitlements stub. Point at the in-repo checkout-api emulator for sandbox restore/fulfill tests — never commit payment secrets.

refundMatrix.playerPath: Play Store → Payments & subscriptions → Budget & history → request refund
refundMatrix.afterRefund: Ownership drops in Play; Restore will not re-grant. Do not hand-edit saves.

refundMatrix.playerPath: Play Store refund flow for the cosmetic order
refundMatrix.opsPath: Play Console → Order management → Refund cosmetic SKU
refundMatrix.afterRefund: Banner unequips on next restore sync; cosmetics stay power-neutral.

refundMatrix.playerPath: Reply to checkout receipt or email support with order id
refundMatrix.opsPath: Checkout provider dashboard → refund → confirm entitlements API no longer returns SKU
refundMatrix.afterRefund: Ask player to Restore purchases once; clear pending entitlement ledger if queued.

refundMatrix.playerPath: Email support with web order id + cosmetic name
refundMatrix.opsPath: Refund in checkout provider; verify GET /v1/entitlements omits the product
refundMatrix.afterRefund: Restore syncs owned=false; presentation banner clears.

knownIssues2.title: Cloud pending upload badge
knownIssues2.symptom: Settings shows pending upload after airplane mode
knownIssues2.workaround: Reconnect; the offline queue flushes the latest snapshot on online/resume. Force flush by toggling cloud sync off/on if stuck.

knownIssues2.title: Locale covers UI chrome first
knownIssues2.symptom: Some content names stay English after switching to Español
knownIssues2.workaround: Expected for Phase 23 scaffold — UI chrome + listing keys are localized; species/quest lore may still be English until a later pass.

knownIssues2.title: Web purchases stay stubbed
knownIssues2.symptom: Web IAP never hits a real checkout URL
knownIssues2.workaround: Set VITE_BILLING_API_BASE (local emulator http://localhost:8787 or production HTTPS). Leave blank for stub-only playtests.

knownIssues2.title: Festival + weather tips stack
knownIssues2.symptom: Sale prices look higher than usual during an event
knownIssues2.workaround: Check festival HUD and weather strip. Tips are catalog-driven and temporary; they do not permanently change wages.
